956123:
**Steps:**
- After turning on the [Pack-A-Punch Machine](#loc=948314), head to the Mutant Research Facility in Tower 1.
- They'll be two monitors that are displaying static and flashing a word:
   - [Monitor](#loc=956127)
   - [Monitor](#loc=956128)
- Take the first letter of each word and head over to the [Periodic Table](#loc=956129).
- Find an element with those two letters as its Atomic Symbol.
   - If only one monitor is flashing a word, only one letter is needed for the element.
- Remember the Atomic Number for the element and head up to the [Keypad](#loc=956130) and enter in the number.
   - If the number is only one or two digits, add a zero to the front to make it three.
- Head inside and head next to the [Cyst Container](#loc=956131).
- Next to it, damage three vermin until they are sucked inside one at a time, then do the same with three zombies.
- Interact with the Cyst Container to acquire [The Cyst](#loc=956137).
- Head to the Quantum Computer Core in Tower 1 and stand near the Aetheric Flora in three different areas of the floor:
   - [Aetheric Flora](#loc=956138)
   - [Aetheric Flora](#loc=956140)
   - [Aetheric Flora](#loc=956141)
- Head to the Dark Entity Containment level in Tower 2. There will be four computers that say Power Surge on the monitors.
- Interact with one and quickly interact with the other three:
   - [Power Surge Computer](#loc=956142)
   - [Power Surge Computer](#loc=956143)
   - [Power Surge Computer](#loc=956144)
   - [Power Surge Computer](#loc=956145)
- After interacting with all of the computers, an Uber Klaus will spawn.
- Shoot the shoulders on the Uber Klaus and have him stand on the [Electrical Pad](#loc=956146).
- The Forsaken inside the machine will combine with the Uber Klaus.
- Kill the Forsaken and interact with the orb that spawn to get the wonder weapon.
956124:
**Steps:**
- First, acquire the [Gorgofex](#loc=956147) from the [Gorgofex Wonder Weapon Easter Egg](#loc=956123).
- Head to the Executive Suite in Tower 1 and interact with the [Metal Door](#loc=956149).
- Head next to the Project Janus Reception level in Tower 1 and interact with the [Button](#loc=956148) next to the Portal.
   - Interacting with the button will lock you out of getting Gorgofex N.
- Protect the Maintenance Klaus until it finishes the Shutdown Sequence.
- One of the elevator shafts in the room will turn off.
- Head up to the Quantum Computing Core in Tower 1 and look down the broken elevator shaft to see three buttons.
- Jump down and, while falling, interact with all three buttons.
- If done correctly, you'll appear back int he Quantum Computer Core.
- Panos will speak as an electrified orb, then split apart.
- He will enter different zombies nearby. Shoot the electrified zombies with the Gorgofex to kill them.
- Once all are killed, Panos will appear. Interact with Panos to receive the Gorgofex C.
956125:
**Steps:**
- First, acquire the [Gorgofex](#loc=956147) from the [Gorgofex Wonder Weapon Easter Egg](#loc=956123).
- Head to the Executive Suite in Tower 1 and interact with the [Metal Door](#loc=956149).
- Head next to the Quantum Computer Core level in Tower 1 and pick up the [Strauss Counter](#loc=959473).
   - Acquiring the Strauss Counter will lock you out of getting Gorgofex C.
- Use the Strauss Counter to find the location in the map with a level of 9 or more.
   - If it says Out of Range, head to the other tower.
- Use a charged Gorgofex shot at the spot that is the highest to receive the [Life Drain Serum](#loc=959474).
- Then, head around the map and pick up three items:
   - [Clean Hood](#loc=959477)
   - [Tubing](#loc=959476)
   - [PC Fan](#loc=959475)
- Bring them all to the [Workbench](#loc=959478) next to the [Metal Door](#loc=956149) in the Executive Suite in Tower 1.
- Assemble the Essence Extractor and defend it during the lockdown.
- Once complete, pick up the essence and bring it to the Bioweapons Lab in Tower 1 and place both the Gorgofex and the Essence into the [Gorgofex N Container](#loc=959480).
- Hold interact on it to infuse it to receive the Gorgofex N.
956126:
**Steps:**
- Head into the T1 Mutant Research Test Area and kill the Geneticist that spawns.
- Pick up the [Keycard](#loc=956132) it drops.
- Using the Keycard, head to the nearby [Freezer](#loc=956133) and open it, then grab the [DNA Vial](#loc=956134) inside.
- Next, head over to the Genome Sequencer and interact with it to acquire the [Syringe](#loc=956135).
- Head to the T2 Sublevel 10 level and, after turning on the [Pack-A-Punch Machine](#loc=948314), jump into the beam.
- You'll turn into a ball of light. Dodge the objects and run into the zombie floating in the beam.
- Interact with the zombie with the Syringe to get a [Blood Sample](#loc=956136).
- Place the Syringe back in the Genome Sequencer to spawn the Fowler-Mangler HVT out of the nearby chamber.
- Kill the Fowler-Mangler, then pick up the [Fowler-Mangler Injector](#loc=956139) it drops.
- Head up to the Dark Entity Containment level in Tower 2 and walk up to the [Scanner](#loc=956150).
- Use the Fowler-Mangler Injector, then interact with the skin.
- This will open up a teleporter to the Teleportation Lab in Tower 2.
- Next, find and interact with four special folders with images in them. There are seven locations that they could spawn:
   - [Folder Spawn](#loc=956153)
   - [Folder Spawn](#loc=956152)
   - [Folder Spawn](#loc=956151)
   - [Folder Spawn](#loc=956154)
   - [Folder Spawn](#loc=956155)
   - [Folder Spawn](#loc=956156)
   - [Folder Spawn](#loc=956157)
- Each are dated and have a number attached to them.
- Right down the number of the files in chronological order to receive a 4 number code.
- Head to the Teleportation Lab in Tower 2 and input the code in the [Code Computer](#loc=956158).
- Next, obtain either the [Gorgofex](#loc=956147), the Gorgofex C, or the Gorgofex N.
- Head to Sublevel 10 in Tower 2 and interact with the [Button](#loc=956159) on the computers.
- This will cause the Particle Accelerator to act up for a period.
- While the Particle Accelerator is overpowered, kill five of the special Vermin that spawn with the Gorgofex.
- Head back to the computer and interact with the [Electrified Orb](#loc=956160) to overcharge the Gorgofex.
- Without shooting the Gorgofex, head back to the Teleportation Lab in Tower 2.
- Using the Gorgofex' charged attack, shoot the crystals around the [Teleporter](#loc=948322) to break them.
   - Do not head into the teleporter at this state, as it will instantly kill you.
- Head to the Quantum Computer Core and shoot the hole in the wall with a charged Gorgofex shot to knock down the [Fungal Head](#loc=956161).
- Pick it up, then head to one of the mop buckets located in three locations:
   - [Mop Bucket](#loc=956163)
   - [Mop Bucket](#loc=956163)
   - [Mop Bucket](#loc=956164)
- Melee the Mop Bucket until it's underneath the nearby sprinklers, then wait until the sprinklers turn on and fill it with water.
   - You can also trigger the sprinklers by throwing a grenade underneath a nearby smoke detector in the three areas.
- Place the Fungal Head into the bucket, then kill zombies near the bucket until the eyes in the head change color.
- Pick up the Fungal Head and head to the Teleporation Lab in Tower 2.
- Place the head into the Teleporter that is now open.
- Next, you'll need to build a Klaus robot. There are four pieces that are needed:
   - Two [Klaus Arms](#loc=956165) are required, which are dropped by the Kommando Klaus robots during the special rounds. Only one arm will drop per special round.
   - Two Klaus Legs:
      - [Klaus Leg Spawn](#loc=956168)
      - [Klaus Leg Spawn](#loc=956166)
      - [Klaus Leg Spawn](#loc=956169)
      - [Klaus Leg Spawn](#loc=956167)
- Head over to the [Franken-Klaus](#loc=956170) and place each part onto it, then wait until an Uber Klaus spawns.
- Get the Uber Klaus to attack nearby to activate the Franken-Klaus.
- Once it is powered on, it'll head to a nearby computer.
- Flip rounds, then bring it to the Dark Entity Containment level in Tower 2.
- Take it to the area underneath the Forsaken bot, then activate the nearby S.A.M. trial.
- Wait for it to hack the S.A.M. trial, then lead it to the Teleportation Lab in Tower 2.
- Head back to the Quantum Computer Core in Tower 1 and, with the [Melee Macchiato](#loc=948237) perk, melee the [Brain Container](#loc=956172), then interact and grab the purple brain inside.
- Quickly bring it back to the Teleportation Lab in Tower Two and place it into the [Brain Container](#loc=956173) next to Franken-Klaus.
- Doing this will unlock the Project Janus Safes around the map:
   - [Project Janus Safe](#loc=956175)
   - [Project Janus Safe](#loc=956176)
   - [Project Janus Safe](#loc=956177)
   - [Project Janus Safe](#loc=956178)
   - [Project Janus Safe](#loc=956179)
- Interact with them until you receive a Vacuum-Seal Device.
- Around the map, purple floating objects will appear.
- Throw the Vacuum-Seal Device at the purple floating object to collect it.
- Repeat the capturing of the items three more times.
- Once you've received four items, head back to the Teleportation Lab in Tower 2 and place them in the [Vacuum-Seal Machine](#loc=956174) in front of the Teleporter.
- A lock down will start and there are five levers around the room. They will light red one at a time.
- Pull four of the levers to end the lockdown and fix the teleporter:
   - [Lever](#loc=956180)
   - [Lever](#loc=956181)
   - [Lever](#loc=956182)
   - [Lever](#loc=956183)
   - [Lever](#loc=956184)
- Head through the teleporter and interact with the Sentinel Artifact, then choose which person to side with.
- Head up the lift and you'll find three L.T.G.s around the area:
   - [L.T.G.](#loc=956186)
   - [L.T.G.](#loc=956187)
   - [L.T.G.](#loc=956188)
- Kill zombies around each to fill them up, then head back to the lift.
- On the next floor, Aether Crystals will spawn on the walls around the area.
- Shoot all the Aether Crystals, then head back to the lift to start the boss fight.

- First, activate the [Pack-A-Punch Machine](#loc=948314) and acquire an ARC-XD scorestreak.

   - [Middle Painting](#loc=959438)
   - [Right Painting](#loc=959430)

- The traps are now upgraded to 2.0
- The traps can be upgraded an additional two times, with 10 more triggers required for 3.0 and 15 more for 4.0.

959459:

- Turn around and five [Cans](#loc=959468) will appear on the yellow scaffolding up the side of the building.
- Shoot all five without missing to receive a free Deadshot Daiquiri perk.
959460:

- Targets will start appearing around the room. Shoot them until completion to receive a random Ammo Mod.
- Flip the round and shoot the Television again. This will spawn two targets at a time around the room.
- Shoot them until completion to receive an Aether Tool.
- Flip the round and shoo the Television a final time. This will spawn moving targets around the room.
- Shoot them until completion to receive an Aetherium Crystal.

- This will cause the figurine to start shooting zombies around you automatically.
